mapper.select: select user_id id, user_name label, status, dept_id from sys_user where user_id=#{id} and del_flag='0'
select dept_id id, dept_name label, status from sys_dept where dept_id=#{id} and del_flag='0'
select user_id id, status, dept_id from sys_user where user_id = #{id} and del_flag = '0' for update
select dept_id id, status from sys_dept where dept_id = #{id} and del_flag = '0' for update
